caption:
the one time an app interrupting me was welcome

#wellnesstips #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
It read the plan
and *pushed back*

Depth jumps, five sets

Great plan — unless
your knee is noted

It names the exact line
that clashes

Before anything starts

Your coach still decides

It just makes sure
the clash is said out loud

Safety isn't a lecture

One honest sentence
at the right moment

slides.heading: It reads the fine print
slides.body: SOMA checks every plan against the injuries you've noted and asks before the block starts — your call, informed
